name: QwenPaw Console Turn Notifications
description:
Shows a native Windows toast when a QwenPaw console turn completes successfully. The text is always “QwenPaw has completed the turn.” Because Windows raises it directly, the toast still appears when the console tab is closed or the browser has quit.

在 QwenPaw 控制台对话成功完成时，显示一条原生 Windows 通知。正文固定为 “QwenPaw has completed the turn.” 由于通知由 Windows 直接发出，即使关闭控制台标签页或退出浏览器，通知依然会显示。

Windows 10/11 only in v1 — macOS and Linux are a silent no-op. Requires QwenPaw 2.2.2–2.3.0. Only successful turns notify; Focus Assist, presentation mode and fullscreen games can still suppress the banner.

v1 仅支持 Windows 10/11，macOS 和 Linux 不会产生任何通知。需要 QwenPaw 2.2.2–2.3.0。只有成功完成的对话才会通知；专注助手、演示模式和全屏游戏仍可能抑制横幅显示。

No browser permission prompt, no console UI or settings page, and no response text is read, stored or transmitted. No Python dependencies and no network access.

不弹出浏览器权限请求，不添加控制台界面或设置页面，也不会读取、保存或传输回复正文。无 Python 依赖，不使用网络访问。
author: BigBunnyBall大兔子球
